title: Steam Gardens Copper
description: Makes copper resemble the copper in Steam Gardens.
body:
This pack simply retextures copper to resemble the copper in the Steam Gardens from _Super Mario Odyssey_.

![Secret Flower Field Tower](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e87c5115f53dabccf5bdc712ca474717c5e45c31.png)

Complete List of Changes :

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Copper Blocks (All Stages)
- Copper Ores
- Lightning Rod
- Raw Copper Block
- Bolt Armor Trim Template
- Brush
- Copper Ingot
- Music Disk Creator, Creator Music Box, & Precipice
- Raw Copper
- Trial Key
- Trial Chambers Map Icon
- Copper Trim Color Pallet

</details>

**Terms for Asset Usage**

I'm ok with my textures being used in your resource pack; My only request is that you credit me in either the _pack.mcmeta_ or in a _README.txt/credits.txt_ in the ZIP, and also noted on the project page.
